title: Accessible Appalachia: An Open-Access Introduction to Appalachian Studies
description: Accessible Appalachia: An Open-Access Introduction to Appalachian Studies is an edited collection of original scholarship. The textbook offers an interdisciplinary perspective and is ideal for introductory classes in Appalachian Studies. Available free to students everywhere, this textbook features coverage of Appalachian artistic, cultural, historical, natural, and social development.
authors: Lisa Day - Editor / Jacob Johnson - Editor
